second_order: joining in and keeping the OKST effort going
theme_note: These turns enact participation: inviting people in, answering the call, enlarging the effort, checking back, and thanking the person who set it up.

second_order: working out what to draw and what to replace
theme_note: These codes hold together as practical design work: sharing a pattern and colours, identifying the art underneath, proposing Cowboy and Oklahoma marks, and drawing the retro target. What varies is whether people specify the shared mark, interpret the existing canvas, or alter pixels toward it.

second_order: moving away from a hotly contested spot
theme_note: Both codes relocate the effort in response to competition at the chosen location; one proposes the move and the other names r/startrek's script as the reason for moving up.

second_order: building bots and scripts to make it
theme_note: These turns shift pixel work into making, adapting, testing, and publishing automation. They vary from calls and plans for bots to the concrete fork, test, work update, and released script.

second_order: saying Place ended and they made their small place
theme_note: These turns close the episode by announcing the end, claiming what the group made, and absorbing the stopped script work with humour. The opening post's edit and later comments give both accomplishment and disappointment.
